content_blocks.title: Core idea
content_blocks.text: Chunking processes an input in batches, but it works best when each chunk can be summarized independently or needs little coordination. Combine partial summaries and test that the result matches a small whole-data baseline.

common_mistakes.problem: Assuming imported data already has the intended schema.
common_mistakes.why: I/O parsing can infer a wrong dtype, encoding, delimiter, date, or missing-value rule.
common_mistakes.fix: Declare or validate the schema after loading and record relevant reader options.
